2. How We Use Your Information

We may use the information we collect to:

  • Create and manage your account
  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Process payments
  • Provide customer support
  • Send order confirmations and updates
  • Process returns and refunds
  • Improve our products and services

3. Payment Information

When you make a purchase, your payment may be processed through third-party payment providers.

We do not intentionally store complete credit card, debit card, or other sensitive payment information on our own servers unless specifically required and legally permitted.

Payment information may be handled directly by the payment service provider according to its own privacy policy and security practices.

4. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to provide a better user experience.

Cookies may help us:

  • Remember your preferences
  • Keep you signed in
  • Maintain your shopping cart
  • Understand how visitors use our website
  • Improve website performance
  • Provide relevant content and services

You can configure your browser to reject or delete cookies. However, disabling certain cookies may affect some website functionality.

5. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

We may share necessary information with trusted service providers when required to operate our website and provide our services. These may include:

  • Payment processing providers
  • Shipping and delivery partners
  • Hosting and cloud service providers
  • Customer support services
  • Website analytics and technology providers
  • Legal or regulatory authorities when required by law

These parties may only receive information necessary to perform their services or fulfill legal obligations.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Therefore, while we work to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, and comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

When information is no longer required, we may securely delete or anonymize it where appropriate.

8. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of certain information
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
  • Request information about how your data is used
  • Object to certain types of processing

To exercise an applicable privacy right, you can contact us using the contact information provided on our website.

9. Account Information

If you create an account with us, you are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.

Please notify us immediately if you believe that your account has been accessed without authorization.

We recommend using a strong and unique password and avoiding sharing your account credentials with others.

10. Children's Privacy

Our website is not intentionally designed to collect personal information from children who are below the minimum age required under applicable law.

If we become aware that personal information has been collected from a child without appropriate authorization, we may take reasonable steps to delete that information.

11. Third-Party Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, services, or applications.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices, security, or content of third-party websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of those websites before providing them with your personal information.

12. Marketing Communications

If you choose to subscribe to our newsletter or promotional communications, we may use your email address to send information about products, offers, promotions, or updates.

You may unsubscribe from promotional emails at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions included in the communication or by contacting us.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, legal requirements, or privacy practices.

When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.

We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

14. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the way we handle your personal information, please contact us through the contact information available on our website.

Return & Refund Policy

Last Updated: September 4, 2026

At ShopMart, we want you to have a positive shopping experience. If you are not satisfied with an eligible product, you may be able to request a return, replacement, or refund according to the conditions described below.

1. Return Period

Eligible products may generally be returned within 7 days of delivery.

The return period may vary depending on the product category or seller. Please check the applicable product and order information before requesting a return.

Products returned after the applicable return period may not be accepted.

2. Return Eligibility

To qualify for a return, the product should generally:

  • Be unused or in acceptable condition
  • Be in its original packaging where applicable
  • Include original accessories and documentation
  • Not be damaged due to customer misuse
  • Be accompanied by the relevant order information

Certain products may have additional return requirements.

3. Non-Returnable Products

Some products may not be eligible for return due to their nature, hygiene requirements, customization, digital delivery, or other applicable restrictions.

Non-returnable products will be identified where applicable on the product page or during the purchasing process.

4. Damaged or Incorrect Products

If you receive a damaged, defective, incomplete, or incorrect product, please contact our customer support team as soon as possible.

You may be required to provide photographs, videos, order details, or other information to help us investigate the issue.

Depending on the circumstances, we may offer a replacement, return, refund, or another appropriate resolution.

5. How to Request a Return

To request a return:

  1. Log in to your ShopMart account.
  2. Open your order history.
  3. Select the relevant order.
  4. Choose the return option, if available.
  5. Provide the required reason and information.
  6. Submit your return request.

Our team may review the request before approving the return.

6. Return Shipping

Return shipping arrangements may depend on the reason for the return and the applicable product policy.

If the product is damaged, defective, incorrect, or otherwise qualifies for a seller-supported return, return shipping may be handled according to the applicable policy.

For customer-requested returns, shipping charges may apply where permitted.

7. Refund Process

Once a returned product has been received and inspected, we will determine whether the return qualifies for a refund.

If approved, the refund will generally be processed using the original payment method where possible.

The time required for the refund to appear in your account may depend on your bank or payment provider.

8. Refund Amount

The refund amount may depend on the reason for the return, product condition, applicable shipping charges, discounts, promotional offers, and other relevant circumstances.

Any applicable deductions will be communicated where required.

9. Order Cancellation

Orders may be cancelled before they are processed or shipped, subject to applicable conditions.

If an eligible cancellation is approved after payment has been received, the applicable amount will be refunded through the available refund method.

Once an order has been shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible and you may need to follow the return procedure.

10. Replacement

For eligible damaged, defective, or incorrect products, we may provide a replacement instead of a refund when the same product is available.

If a replacement is unavailable, another appropriate resolution may be offered according to the applicable policy.

11. Refund Delays

Although we process approved refunds as quickly as reasonably possible, banks and payment providers may require additional processing time.

If you have not received an expected refund after the applicable processing period, please contact our support team with your order details.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions about returns, refunds, replacements, or cancellations, please contact our customer support team.

ShopMart
